notes: Monthly values rounded to 2 decimals (CSV precision).
region = macro region holding the largest share of the province's cell-days (regions are latitude bands; region_share lists every band the province touches, from grid10km_monthly_harmonized.csv).
peak_month: calendar month (1-12) with the highest mean monthly value over 2012-02..2026-10, same recipe as check_outputs.py.
trend: Theil-Sen % per year and Kendall tau on annual sums of full years, same definition as trend_check.csv (computed here, not by the pipeline).
band_rel_width_median: median (hi-lo)/harmonized over months with harmonized >= 1.
Bands reflect calibration + operator uncertainty (shared across provinces), not local sampling noise (report.md).
